subject: Invitation: BrightMode — Scaling LLM Inference in Production (panel)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Gomez <lina@brightmode.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Invitation: BrightMode — Scaling LLM Inference in Production (panel)

Hi Lina —

Hope you’re well. I’m reaching from Redwood Inference to invite BrightMode to join a short panel we’re producing for the GenerativeAI Summit (virtual + small in-person hub) titled “Scaling LLM Inference in Production: customer deep dives.” We’d love to feature BrightMode as a 20–25 minute case study + live Q&A — the format would be: 12–15 minute customer story (operations, tradeoffs, measurable outcomes), ~5 minutes demo screenshot/walkthrough, and ~10 minutes audience Q&A.

Proposed windows: Dec 15–17 between 10:00–13:00 PT. If those don’t work we can find other dates in January. We can accommodate 1–2 BrightMode speakers; happy to have your ML lead + an engineering manager.

Logistics we’ll handle: AV, attendee registration, and a short marketing spot on the summit site. We ask for a 1–2 sentence testimonial we can use in promo and a single-slide architecture diagram for the demo portion. We’ll also run a 30-minute prep call with the speaker(s) one week before the event and provide slide templates and speaker guidelines.

Budget/honorarium: we typically offer an honorarium for dedicated customer sessions — I’ll confirm in the follow-up once we lock dates.

Would BrightMode be open to this? If yes, can you share preferred speakers and any date constraints?

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Customer Partnerships | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
[Attachment: BrightMode_Speaker_Guidelines.pdf]

From: Lina Gomez <lina@brightmode.com>

Cc: Tom Reilly <tom.reilly@brightmode.com>, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invitation: BrightMode — Scaling LLM Inference in Production (panel)

Hi Jonas —

Thanks — this sounds great and timely for us. Tom (cc) and I chatted briefly and we’re interested. Two quick questions before we lock in: 1) Do you expect a slide deck? If so, how many slides and is there a template? 2) Is there an honorarium or stipend for customer speakers? Also, we have internal calendar constraints during Dec 15–17 (end-of-quarter), so Jan dates would be preferable.

Tom — can you confirm availability for a 20–25 min slot in early January (we prefer mornings PT)?

Best,
Lina
Lina Gomez
Head of Customer Success | BrightMode
lina@brightmode.com
[Attachment: none]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Gomez <lina@brightmode.com>, Tom Reilly <tom.reilly@brightmode.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invitation: BrightMode — Scaling LLM Inference in Production (panel)

Great — thanks Lina. Quick answers:

- Slide deck: Yes, please prepare up to 7 slides (title, problem, architecture, metrics/outcomes, demo screenshots, lessons learned, CTA). We’ll provide a template and speaker notes. See attached speaker guidelines PDF (copied from the earlier attachment).
- Honorarium: We offer a $1,000 honorarium for customer presenters for this session (virtual). If BrightMode prefers a swag/marketing credit instead, we can arrange that; let us know.
- Dates: Understood on Dec. Let’s target the week of Jan 12–16. Can you share 2–3 preferred windows? We’ll schedule the prep call ~7 days prior.

Prep timeline & items we’ll need:
1) Short speaker bio (1–2 sentences) + headshot (JPG/PNG) — due 10 days before event
2) Final slide deck — due 3 days before event
3) 1–2 sentence pull-quote/testimonial we can use in promo — due with the bio
4) Any compliance notes / NDA redlines — send to monica (cc) if needed

Attachments I’m sending now: Redwood Speaker Agreement (Doc) and the BrightMode_Speaker_Guidelines.pdf we referenced. Please expect a DocuSign link for the agreement; signing is required before we publish any promo.

If Jan 12–16 looks doable, share 2–3 slots (mornings PT) and we’ll lock the calendar and send a calendar invite for the prep call.

Thanks — excited to have BrightMode.

—Jonas
[Attachments: Redwood_Speaker_Agreement.docx, BrightMode_Speaker_Guidelines.pdf]
